extracted.summary: A scholarship for Backward Class and Economically Backward Class students from Telangana pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate or Ph.D. courses abroad.
extracted.amount_text: up to INR 20,00,000 or as mentioned in the admission letter, whichever is less.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have secured a minimum of 60% in the previous qualifying examination.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual family income below INR 5,00,000 from all sources.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Economically Backward Class (EBC) category.
extracted.course_levels_quote: An initiative for BC and EBC category students pursuing UG, PG and Ph.D. level courses abroad.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a Telangana resident.
extracted.max_age_quote: Applicants must not be more than 35 years of age as on 1st July of the year of advertisement.
